description: A souvenir shop makes wooden elephants and tigers with plastic ornaments. Each elephant requires 50 grams of wood and 20 grams of plastic. Each tiger requires 40 grams of wood and 30 grams of plastic. In a week, 5000 grams of wood and 4000 grams of plastic are available. The profit per elephant sold is $5 and the profit per tiger sold is $4. How many of each should be made in order to maximize profit?

Profit.definition: Profit per unit of each product

ResourceRequirement.definition: Amount of each resource required to produce one unit of each product

ResourceAvailability.definition: Amount of each resource available per week

objective.description: "The goal is to maximize the total profit from producing and selling wooden elephants and tigers."

constraints.description: 50 times the number of elephants produced plus 40 times the number of tigers produced should not exceed 5000 grams of wood available per week
20 times the number of elephants produced plus 30 times the number of tigers produced should not exceed 4000 grams of plastic available per week
The number of elephants produced should be greater than or equal to 0
The number of tigers produced should be greater than or equal to 0
